exact_statement:
theorem universal_group_of_type_FInfinity :
    ∃ (H : Type u) (groupH : Group H),
      @HasTypeFInfinity H groupH ∧
      ∀ (G : Type u) [Group G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G],
        ∃ φ : G →* H, Function.Injective φ
